instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Custom furniture manufacturer crafting solid wood pieces for hospitality and high-end residential projects. Blend of CNC routing for repetitive components with traditional joinery for finishing. Evaluating digital twin assembly planning to reduce custom project lead times from 12 to 7 weeks. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 6 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 5 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Digital Customer Experience Modernization for Retention
opportunities.rationale: The urgent decline in customer retention (92% to 84%) is directly linked to product stagnation and poor digital self-service. This opportunity focuses on developing a robust, modern customer portal that addresses mid-tier/enterprise pain points before competitors do.

first_actions: Conduct competitive teardowns of digital self-service portals in the furniture/hospitality sector.
Prioritize features based on exit interview data (e.g., product configurator, lifecycle tracking).
Define technical debt remediation roadmap specifically for customer-facing systems.
resources_needed: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) Scope Definition Time
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in feature utilization rate via the new portal by 25% within 6 months.
milestones: Finalized customer journey map and prioritized backlog.
Deployment of functional MVP (e.g., accurate quote generation).
Positive anecdotal feedback increase from sales team.

opportunities.title: Scaling Operational Intelligence via IIoT Integration
opportunities.rationale: The initial pilot of IoT sensors successfully reduced unplanned downtime by 15%, validating the business case. The next phase must systematically integrate the full fleet rollout, focusing heavily on overcoming complex legacy system integration challenges.

first_actions: Identify and allocate resources for a specialized industrial systems integrator to manage procurement complexity.
Map out data flow architecture between IoT sensors, SCADA, and the existing maintenance system.
Develop standardized training protocol for operational staff on new predictive maintenance alerts.
execution_plan.success_metric: Deployment of monitoring across 80% of target production equipment, achieving a sustained 25%+ reduction in unplanned downtime.
milestones: Successful integration test on two major machine types.
Full business case funding secured and committed.

next_steps.action: Define a specialized, dedicated roadmap for the customer-facing digital platform (opp_4), separating it from core product development.
Execute vendor selection for the IIoT integration project, focusing on mitigating legacy system compatibility risks.
Hold weekly cross-functional strategy sessions to jointly analyze churn data and technical debt, linking operational efficiency (IoT) back to market retention.

key_weaknesses: Founder's single point of failure (over-reliance on personal bandwidth for key decisions).
Lack of formal, specialized in-house engineering expertise to manage complex technology investments.
Critical disconnect between successful operational efficiency gains (IoT) and the declining customer retention/digital experience.

improvements: Successful product iteration (6 new features launched) improving NPS by 5 points.
Validated proof-of-concept for IIoT, resulting in a strong business case approval for full fleet rollout.
Increased budget allocation to innovation (14% from 11%).
persistent_gaps: The core strategic vulnerability of customer retention remains critical and unaddressed by current operational improvements.
Management structure is still informal, impeding the scaling required for enterprise growth.
Technical debt continues to accumulate despite successful feature launches.
achieved_milestones: 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines (IoT pilot).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Improved operational visibility and product execution momentum (NPS increase; IoT pilot success). However, the strategic focus has shifted sharply from purely internal process optimization to addressing a critical external market failure: severe customer churn due to poor digital self-service.
